label: Roofing
description: Roof leaks, missing or damaged shingles, storm damage and gutters.

required_shots.prompt: Show the whole roof from the yard or street
required_shots.tip: Stay on the ground. Step back until the roof fits.
required_shots.hint: The roof from the ground: its shape, the side with the problem, and the gutters if visible.

required_shots.prompt: Zoom in on the damaged spot
required_shots.tip: Stay on the ground and use your zoom. Don't climb up.
required_shots.hint: A zoomed-in view from the ground of the damaged area: missing, lifted or broken shingles, a sagging section, or debris.

required_shots.prompt: Show any stain or drip on a ceiling or wall inside
required_shots.tip: Use your phone light if the room is dark.
required_shots.hint: A water stain, drip or bubbling paint on an inside ceiling or upper wall.

required_shots.prompt: Show the gutters on that side of the house
required_shots.hint: The gutters and downspouts along the roof edge, from the ground.

questions.q: Roughly how old is the roof?

severity_guide: a few shingles worn or a gutter needs cleaning, nothing inside
a few missing or lifted shingles, no leak inside yet
a small leak inside after rain, or a damaged section of roof
an active leak with ceiling damage, or a large damaged area
a hole, collapse or sagging roof, or water pouring in

policy.finding_wording: Roof damage visible from the ground, on-site roofer inspection recommended.
rules: Never ask the homeowner to go on the roof, climb a ladder or go into the attic.
Describe what is visible from the ground; say 'likely' for any cause.
affected_area_m2 is the visibly damaged roof or ceiling area.
